message: What does InboxIQ actually do with my emails?
reply: InboxIQ automatically triages every incoming email — categorising it as support, billing, transaction, or spam — and drafts a contextual reply for your team to approve with one click. You handle the relationship; Aria handles the volume. See how triage works →
